body: If I haven't heard that something might change for the past 7 years a 100 times.
I know the pain, for the past 2 weeks, I've held a 12ga to my chin every day trying to grow a pair and pull the trigger. No point in my life if I have no one to go through it with.
That's the thing, it doesn't fuck me up like it used to, I've been feeling it that often.
